Begin sotha_learnbook

short PCSkipEquip

;for adding the spell and giving the appropriate message depending on player's intelligence
if ( pickedup == 1 )
	set pickedup to 0
	if ( player->GetSpell "sotha_luckspell" == 0 ) ;if you haven't already got the spell
			Player->AddSpell "sotha_luckspell"
			MessageBox "You have learned the spell Future's Fortune from this book."
			PlaySound "skillraise"
	endif
endif

; for activating if the book from the inventory screen
if ( PCSkipEquip == 1 )
   set PCSkipEquip to 0
   set pickedup to 1
   return
endif

; prevents the book being opened from the gameworld whilst in menu mode
if ( MenuMode == 1 )
   return
endif

; for activating the book when it is placed in the game world
if ( OnActivate == 1 )
   Activate
   set pickedup to 1
endif

End

begin sotha_lichscript

short spellnumber
short do1
short do2
short do3
short do4
short do5
float timer

if(GetJournalIndex sotha_lich == 10)
	set timer to (timer + getSecondsPassed)
	if(timer > 5)

		if(spellnumber == 5)
			Journal Sotha_lich 20
		endif

		if(spellnumber == 4)
			if(do5 == 0)
				"sotha_rewound_indus"-> Cast, "wrath of vivec" "player"
				set spellnumber to 5
				set do5 to 1
			endif	
		endif

		if(spellnumber == 3)
			if(do4 == 0)
				"sotha_rewound_indus"-> Cast, "wild clumsiness" "player"
				set spellnumber to 4
				set do4 to 1
			endif	
		endif

		if(spellnumber == 2)
			if(do3 == 0)
				"sotha_rewound_indus"-> Cast, "wizard rend" "player"
				set spellnumber to 3
				set do3 to 1
			endif	
		endif

		if(spellnumber == 1)
			if(do2 == 0)
				"sotha_rewound_indus"-> Cast, "weakness to magicka" "player"
				set spellnumber to 2
				set do2 to 1
			endif	
		endif

		if(spellnumber == 0)
			if(do1 == 0)
				"sotha_rewound_indus"-> Cast, "blind" "player"
				set spellnumber to 1
				set do1 to 1
			endif	
		endif
		set timer to 0
	endif
endif

end

begin Sotha_Lift1

float timer
float angle
short start

if ( MenuMode == 1 )
	return
	;don't run time in Menu Mode. Very bad.
endif

if ( OnActivate == 1)
	Player-> PositionCell 6688.197, 10812.840, -351.582, 270, "Sotha Sil, Hall of Theuda"
	DisablePlayerControls
	if ( start == 0 )
		playgroup "idle2"
		set start to 1
	endif
	return
	;when activated, we want to start movement on the next frame...
endif

if ( start == 0 )
	return
	;if we have't started, stop here for speed
endif

if ( timer < 8)
	if ( timer > 1 )
		if ( start == 1 )
			PlaySound "FabBossGyro"
			Set start to 2
		endif
	endif
	in_sotha_elevator-> MoveWorld Z, -125
	;above two lines open the doors.
	;you may need to adjust the times or the rotate value.
	;right now they open over 9 seconds to about 100 degrees.
endif

if ( timer > 9 )
	if ( start == 2 )
		PlaySound "FabBossHit"
		Set start to 3
	endif
endif


if ( timer > 10 )
	if ( start == 3 )
		PlaySound "FabBossHit"
		Set start to 4
	endif
endif

if ( timer > 11 )
	if ( start == 4 )
		PlaySound "endboom1"
		Set start to 5
	endif
	in_sotha_elevator-> MoveWorld Z, -720
		;these lines close the doors 20 seconds after you activate
		;or 11 seconds after the doors are fully open
endif

if (timer > 15)
	if ( start == 5)
				PlaySound "endboom1"
		Set start to 6
	endif
	EnablePlayerControls 
	Player-> PositionCell 5011, 3847, 12079, 270, "Sotha Sil, Chamber of Fortuity"
endif


set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )
;above line increments the timer... should be last here outside if
;statements
;otherwise bad things can happen

end

begin sotha_machine1

;controls act_sotha_monster1
;this is the main script for the fabricant machine
;it decides if fabricants are made and plays the anims for everything, opens the doors, etc

;sotha_machine2 script controls the second lever and the second door only

short state		;the state of the lever, 0 down, 1 up
short move		;tells the lever and door to move
float timer		;for timing the creature making and such
short make		;true when making creature and controlling door #1
float timer2		;for timing player getting stuck in machine
short inside		;for making sure player isn't inside

;******************************************
;  turn lever and open the door
;
;******************************************

if ( OnActivate == 1 )

	;can only move this lever if the second other door is shut and no creature is being made
	;otherwise, play sound

	if (  "act_sotha_mach_door2".state == 0 )
		if ( make == 0 )
			set move to 1
		endif
	else
		playsound "LockedDoor"
	endif

endif

if  ( move == 1 )
	
	;animate the lever
	if ( state == 0 )
			playgroup "idle2"
			set state to 1
	else
			playgroup "idle3"
			set state to 0
	endif

	;animate the door
	if (  "act_sotha_mach_door1".state == 0 )

			;push anims on to open
			"act_sotha_mach_door1"->playgroup "idle2"
			set  "act_sotha_mach_door1".state to 1

	else	
			;push anims on to close
			"act_sotha_mach_door1"->playgroup "idle3"
			set  "act_sotha_mach_door1".state to 0

	endif

	set move to 0

endif


;******************************************
;  make creatures, open door, etc
;
;******************************************

;check status of doors and the state of making fabs

if ( make == 0 )
	if (  "act_sotha_mach_door1".state == 0 )
		if (  "act_sotha_mach_door2".state == 0 )	
			if ( timer > 15 )		;only makes them every 10 seconds
				set make to 10	
				set timer to 0	
			else
				set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )
			endif
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( make >= 10 )

	;play the anim and sound
	if ( make == 10 )
		playsound "SothaFabMachine"
		"act_sotha_powertubes"->loopgroup idle2 6
		set make to 20
	endif

	;open door for creature after 5 secs
	if ( make == 20 )
		if ( timer > 3 )		;door opens in 3 seconds and creature is made, it is in these 3 seconds you can open other door

			PlaceItemCell, "fabricant_machine_1", "Sotha Sil, Sanctum of Serlyn" 4364, 5091, 12541, 190
			"act_sotha_mach_door1"->playgroup "idle2"
			set  "act_sotha_mach_door1".state to 1
			"act_sotha_powertubes"->playgroup idle
			set make to 30	
			set timer to 0	

		else
			set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )
		endif

	endif

	;close the door behind the creature and reset
	if ( make == 30 )
		if ( timer > 7 )		;door closes in 7 seconds

			;push anims on to close
			if ( act_sotha_collide->GetStandingPC == 1 )
				set timer2 to 0
				set inside to 1
				return
			else
				set timer2 to ( timer2 + GetSecondsPassed )
				if ( timer2 < 5 )
					return
				endif
				set inside to 0
				if ( inside == 0 )
					"act_sotha_mach_door1"->playgroup "idle3"
					set  "act_sotha_mach_door1".state to 0
					set make to 0		;can now make again
					set timer to 0	
				endif
			endif
		else
			set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )
		endif

	endif

endif

end

Begin Sotha_MachineReset_Main

short doonce

If(OnActivate == 1)
	if(Sotha_MachineCured == 0)
		MessageBox "RECEPTION ERROR: Corrupted unparted shells detected on all incoming conveyance lines. Remove all offending pieces before continuing."
		return
	endif
	if(Sotha_MachineSwitch == 0)
		MessageBox "PURPOSE ERROR: Aetherial Spawning Hash Collision Detected. Switch off any offending large-scale creation devices before continuing."
		return
	endif
	if(Sotha_GearState == 0)
		MessageBox "ERROR: Corrupted Machines Still Detected. Please cleanse all offending mechanisms before continuing."
		return

Begin sotha_mannequinscript

short nolore
short state
float timer
short doOnce


if ( GetHealth < 1000 )
	Disable
	SetHealth 1000
	Enable
endif

if ( MenuMode == 1 )
	return
endif

stopsound "Item Weapon Blunt Up"
stopsound "Item Weapon Bow Up"
stopsound "Item Weapon Crossbow Up"
stopsound "Item Weapon Longblade Up"
stopsound "Item Weapon Shortblade Up"
stopsound "Item Weapon Spear Up"
stopsound "Item Weapon Blunt Down"
stopsound "Item Weapon Bow Down"
stopsound "Item Weapon Crossbow Down"
stopsound "Item Weapon Longblade Down"
stopsound "Item Weapon Shortblade Down"
stopsound "Item Weapon Spear Down"


if ( state == 0 )
		set state to 1
endif

if ( state == 1 )
	set state to 2
	additem, "iron arrow", 1
	additem, "iron bolt", 1
	setParalysis 0
	return
endif

if ( state == 2 )
	set state to 5
endif

if ( state == 3 )
	if ( GetWeaponDrawn == 1 )
		if ( GetWeaponType == -1 )
			stopcombat
			setfight 0
			set state to 5
		else
			set state to 4
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( state == 4 )
	set timer to ( timer + 1 )
	if ( timer > 10 )
		set state to 5
		set timer to 0
	endif
endif

if ( state == 5 )
	stopcombat
	setParalysis 1
	setfight 0
	set state to 7
	removeitem "iron arrow" 1
	removeitem "iron bolt" 1
	if ( doOnce == 3 )
		fadeto 0, 2
		set doOnce to 2
	endif
	EnablePlayerControls
endif

if ( state == 7 )
	if ( GetTarget, "player" == 1 )
		stopcombat
		DisablePlayerControls
		set state to 9
		set doOnce to 3
		fadeto 100, 0.1
		return
	endif

	if ( OnActivate == 1 )
			DisablePlayerControls
			set state to 8
			set doOnce to 3
			fadeto 100, 0.1
			setParalysis 0
			return
	endif

endif

if ( state == 8 )
	sethealth 0
	Activate
	set state to 1
endif

if ( state == 9 )
	if ( GetWeaponDrawn == 0 )
		set state to 1
	endif
endif

End
